_comments: bizapps-tasks' first row-level security filters (the meetings plan, § 4): a Standard meeting is readable by anyone who reads meetings; a Private one only by its attendees, the organizer included, found by the attendee's UserID. Parenthesised so each ANDs onto any other filter the caller holds; TRY_CAST so a missing user id matches nothing.
Pushed before the entities folder, which references them: MemberJunction refuses a change to a filter with a subquery once a permission names it.

fields.Name: Tasks: Visible Meetings
fields.Description: A Standard meeting, or a Private meeting the caller is an attendee of.
fields.FilterText: (Visibility = N'Standard' OR ID IN (SELECT MeetingID FROM [__mj_BizAppsTasks].[vwMeetingAttendees] WHERE UserID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)))

fields.Name: Tasks: Rows Of Visible Meetings
fields.Description: A row (an attendee, an agenda item, a note) of a meeting the caller may see: Standard, or Private with the caller among its attendees.
fields.FilterText: (MeetingID IN (SELECT ID FROM [__mj_BizAppsTasks].[vwMeetings] WHERE Visibility = N'Standard' OR ID IN (SELECT MeetingID FROM [__mj_BizAppsTasks].[vwMeetingAttendees] WHERE UserID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER))))

fields.Name: Tasks: Visible Meeting Links
fields.Description: A link of a series, or of a meeting the caller may see.
fields.FilterText: (MeetingID IS NULL OR MeetingID IN (SELECT ID FROM [__mj_BizAppsTasks].[vwMeetings] WHERE Visibility = N'Standard' OR ID IN (SELECT MeetingID FROM [__mj_BizAppsTasks].[vwMeetingAttendees] WHERE UserID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER))))
